name: scrubber
title: Scrubber
description: A horizontal value scrubber: drag across a labelled track to set a number, with tick marks and a capsule thumb.

props.name: label
props.description: Label shown on the left of the track. Also the accessible name.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value while dragging or using the keyboard.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Decimal places shown in the readout.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Number of tick marks. 0 hides them.
